description: Per-model scale overrides exported from the old generator's library.db (table scale_overrides), so they survive a database rebuild. A row is keyed as the DB keys it: pack name, FBX path inside the pack, body variant ('' for the whole file). `scale` multiplies the model's root nodes to get true metres and replaces the automatic fix (synty/scale.ts). Regenerate with `npm run scale-overrides -w @slop/library` against the real data dir; the library test checks the DB and this file agree.

overrides.name: SM_Wep_German_Pistol_01
overrides.why: Modelled 10x larger than its pack siblings: the pack-wide auto fix (100) makes the luger 2.3 m long, and an aligned export that holds it fails validation with frame_overflow. With 10 it is 0.23 m.
